text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work~!
Digi-tan finished on the board☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~, did you see that? The way the 1st place girl ran...!
She was shining so brilliantly the moment she crossed the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, so precious. My blessedness meter is maxed out.
choice_data_list: Next time, you'll be the one taking 1st place.
Next time, let's take 1st place ourselves, okay?

text_block_list.text: Ah, so precious. My blessedness meter is maxed out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All of this is thanks to the Umamusume!
Having them around is what keeps me going, after all...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Even today's runners...!
Aren't they all just too emotional?! First of all, that girl is..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, she started talking passionately about the charm
of every single Umamusume who ran in that race...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ouch...! That hits a sore spot, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I didn't have enough resolve
to say, "I'm going to take 1st place!"...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I need to brace myself even more and devote myself
to running in a way that doesn't shame my idol... ngh!"
